title: Digga le xongolo
intro: ta cankah kassitam adda xer cogdaa kee miracsenta, xayyos fayuh hora horah. ken qangor taqwa sumaq kee tuxxiiqih mamaxxaga barkat kee gibbatu yallih gabat. Ta kunnabna le roocih mamaxxaga reebisaanama.
clues: Anu farmoytak masugiyyo, takkay immay yi wale qibaadah kitaabak amotani.
Yi baxah liyo fayi Yallah faatitaanam kee shirkik waasimaanam diggossa.
Anu dooqah tuxxiq barseh, meqem amrisaanam kee umam waasaanam.
Anu kaxxiina kee ardi bagul duquurinna luk gexaanamih takkaawisa.
Yi migaq Qur'aanak inkih tan mafdagal yomcowwe, yi barsiyyih ammunta.
yi fayi edde anuk sabri gibdaabinitteh addat, nummaak, toh kaxxam fidga le caagiidak.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Isi ummatta miraacisak qusba baaxo fan miraacise.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
